caveats.en: Ricochet kernel anti-cheat has no Arm64 driver yet. XDA saw Warzone crash on launch on RTX Spark, and Activision lists only Intel/AMD CPUs. NVIDIA says Call of Duty is coming to RTX Spark in 2027.
caveats.zh-TW: Ricochet 核心層反作弊尚無 Arm64 驅動程式。XDA 在 RTX Spark 上實測《戰區》一啟動就當掉，Activision 也只列出 Intel/AMD 處理器。NVIDIA 表示《決勝時刻》要到 2027 年才會支援 RTX Spark。
